LeaderboardProvenance.description:
Whether anybody published a number for this model, on this task.

`not_reported` is not zero. A model whose card publishes no summarization or
faithfulness result has an unknown prior, and recording that as `0.0` would
put a fabricated worst case into every mean, chart and comparison that ever
reads the column (Rule #10).
LeaderboardProvenance.title: LeaderboardProvenance

ValidationVerdict.title: ValidationVerdict

changelog.change: leaderboard_hhem may be null beside a leaderboard_provenance of not_reported, and the verdict set gained qualified and not_qualified.
changelog.why: A single-model qualification has no incumbent to compare against, and the candidate's model card publishes no summarization or faithfulness result. Recording that absence as 0.0 invents a worst case. Older rows carry a float and read as reported, which is the read-side migration.

changelog.change: Initial shape: the incumbent and its challengers, measured and predicted.
changelog.why: Row #7 is an ESCALATE gate, so its inputs and its verdict are a persisted contract rather than a paragraph in a pull request.
